drums.tags: Industrial Techno with heavy EBM influences. The track features a distorted, overdriven kick drum with a long sub-tail and a metallic, resonant snare. A syncopated, percussive synth sequence with a high-pass filter sweep runs throughout. Distorted, white-noise-heavy industrial textures and mechanical clangs are layered over the percussion. A dark, monophonic bass synth plays a repetitive two-note pattern. The tempo is 135 BPM in the key of D minor. High-frequency hi-hats play a constant sixteenth-note pattern with varying velocity. Occasional glitch effects and bit-crushed transitions punctuate the arrangement.

bass.tags: Industrial techno with heavy EBM influences. A distorted, overdriven kick drum provides a relentless pulse at 135 BPM in the key of D minor. A resonant, acid-style synth bassline follows a syncopated 16th-note pattern with frequent filter cutoff modulation. Metallic percussion hits and white noise snares occur on the backbeat, processed with short room reverb. A high-pitched, dissonant lead synth enters periodically with a staccato, rhythmic sequence. Dark, atmospheric pads with long release times create a dense background texture. The track features aggressive, distorted male spoken-word vocals with heavy compression and a bitcrushed effect. A rhythmic gate is applied to the vocal track in certain sections, syncing with the 16th-note grid. The arrangement is built on incremental layer additions and subtractive breakdowns.
